component.name: nutty
component.summary: Monitor UPS units, power stations and batteries

description.p: nutty lives in the system tray and keeps an eye on everything that powers your computer. It watches NUT servers, apcupsd, EcoFlow power stations, Home Assistant sensors and the operating system's own batteries, and tells you as soon as something changes.

ul.li: Monitor several devices at once, local or remote
Desktop, Pushover, ntfy, email, webhook and PagerDuty notifications
Sleep, hibernate or shut down on low battery or low runtime, with a countdown you can cancel
A dated history of every outage, with charge and load charts
Follows the system light and dark theme
